modmenu.descriptionTranslation.key_bindi: A simple mod for hiding specific key bindings in the GUI.
gui.key_binding_hider.missing_cloth_conf:
You'll need to install the Cloth Config mod to use the in-game configuration feature.
Click the button below to jump to the download page
config.key_binding_hider.@footer:
Entries starting with §6#§r are treated as RegExp.
Example: §a#key\.jei\..*§r hides all JEI key bindings.
config.key_binding_hider.general.HiddenK: Set hidden key bindings to Unknown to prevent key binding conflicts.
Key bindings with IDs matching any of these patterns will be hidden.
config.key_binding_hider.general.HiddenC: Key bindings whose category matches any of these patterns will be hidden.
